progression.narrative: The performance opens on A4 and dwells most on A in Daramad. The line peaks at A4 (443.2 Hz) at 1:52.7. It closes on Fs4, not the tonic (Fs4 → Gs4 → A4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4).
